title: convolith provenance observation v1
description: One observation of a canonical event: which source record produced or corroborated it. Mirrors src/model.rs::ProvenanceRef and the ledger `observation` table (src/ledger.rs).

source_id.description: Deterministic source id over (display path, container chain).

source_path.description: Path as discovered, before any normalization. For a staged archive member this is `outer.tgz!/inner/path`.

container_chain.description: Full archive ancestry, outermost first, e.g. ["server-backup.tar.gz", "home/user/.codex/session.jsonl"].

record_index.description: Zero-based index of the record inside the source (JSONL line, DB row, archive entry).

record_id.description: Provider-native record id when the source carries one.

parser.description: Parser id that read the record, e.g. `claude_code`, `codex`, `chatgpt`, `generic_jsonl`.

parser_version.description: Parser API version; bumped whenever a parser changes the canonical output it produces.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source bytes this observation was read from, when hashed.

first_seen.description: When this source record was first imported.

import_run.description: Import run that recorded this observation.

identity_tier.description: Identity tier that established this observation. `native` = globally unique provider id; `coordinates` = provider-local id or stable position within the conversation; `fingerprint` = conversation + sequence + role + content fingerprint.
